{{Quote|Whoa! Put on your retro-rockets!|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>}}
A '''retrorocket''',<ref name="Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back novelization">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'']]</ref> also known as a '''braking jet''' or '''braking thruster''', was a type of braking rocket<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref> or retrothruster<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref> used to counteract motion and decelerate or stop a [[Starship/Legends|space vessel]] or other craft.
